modules.name: GTDefs
modules.source:
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset

namespace GT

/-- Edge sets: ordered pairs (u, v), read as the edge {u, v}. Hosts list each edge once, with u < v. -/
abbrev Edges := Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

/-- No three edges (a, b), (b, c), (a, c). -/
def TriangleFree (S : Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, ¬ (e.1 = g.1 ∧ e.2 = f.1 ∧ f.2 = g.2)

instance (S : Edges) : Decidable (TriangleFree S) := by
  unfold TriangleFree; infer_instance

end GT

modules.name: HSDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace HS

/-- History predicate: every pair is listed as (u, v) with u < v. -/
def Simple (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S, e.1 < e.2

/-- History predicate: every endpoint is below 8. -/
def Bounded8 (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S, e.1 < 8 ∧ e.2 < 8

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (Simple S) := by unfold Simple; infer_instance
instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (Bounded8 S) := by unfold Bounded8; infer_instance

end HS

modules.name: HSConj
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs
set_option linter.unusedVariables false

namespace HSConj
/-- Generated conjecture `down_tf` (history). -/
def down_tf : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : T ⊆ S) (h2 : GT.TriangleFree S), GT.TriangleFree T
/-- Generated conjecture `down_simple` (history). -/
def down_simple : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : T ⊆ S) (h2 : HS.Simple S), HS.Simple T
/-- Generated conjecture `down_bounded` (history). -/
def down_bounded : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : T ⊆ S) (h2 : HS.Bounded8 S), HS.Bounded8 T
/-- Generated conjecture `inter_tf` (history). -/
def inter_tf : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : GT.TriangleFree S), GT.TriangleFree (S ∩ T)
/-- Generated conjecture `inter_simple` (history). -/
def inter_simple : Prop := ∀ (S : GT.Edges) (T : GT.Edges) (h1 : HS.Simple S), HS.Simple (S ∩ T)
end HSConj

modules.name: RCDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs

namespace RC

/-- Recovered by typed anti-unification of HSConj.down_bounded, HSConj.down_simple, HSConj.down_tf. -/
def C0 (P0 : GT.Edges -> Prop) : Prop := (∀ (x0 : @GT.Edges), (∀ (x1 : @GT.Edges), (∀ (x2 : (@LE.le @GT.Edges (@Preorder.toLE @GT.Edges (@PartialOrder.toPreorder @GT.Edges (@Finset.instPartialOrder (@Prod @Nat @Nat)))) x1 x0)), (∀ (x3 : (P0 x0)), (P0 x1)))))

end RC

modules.name: G4Defs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace G4

/-- Domain contract (c4_host_v2): u and v are joined in S, in either orientation. -/
def adj (S : GT.Edges) (u v : ℕ) : Prop := (u, v) ∈ S ∨ (v, u) ∈ S

instance (S : GT.Edges) (u v : ℕ) : Decidable (adj S u v) := by
  unfold adj; infer_instance

def verts (S : GT.Edges) : Finset ℕ := S.image Prod.fst ∪ S.image Prod.snd

/-- No 4-cycle a-b-c-d-a with a ≠ c and b ≠ d. -/
def C4Free (S : GT.Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ verts S, ∀ b ∈ verts S, ∀ c ∈ verts S, ∀ d ∈ verts S,
    a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (adj S a b ∧ adj S b c ∧ adj S c d ∧ adj S d a)

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (C4Free S) := by
  unfold C4Free; infer_instance

end G4

modules.name: FFDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import G4Defs

namespace FF

/-- Fresh predicate: no loops. -/
def LoopFree (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S, e.1 ≠ e.2

/-- Fresh predicate: distinct pairs share no endpoint. -/
def Matching (S : GT.Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → e.1 ≠ f.1 ∧ e.1 ≠ f.2 ∧ e.2 ≠ f.1 ∧ e.2 ≠ f.2

/-- Fresh predicate that is not down-closed. -/
def NonEmpty (S : GT.Edges) : Prop := S.Nonempty

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (LoopFree S) := by unfold LoopFree; infer_instance
instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (Matching S) := by unfold Matching; infer_instance
instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (NonEmpty S) := by unfold NonEmpty; infer_instance

end FF

FFNP1
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import HSDefs
import HSConj
import RCDefs
import G4Defs
import FFDefs
import FFNConj
namespace FFNP1
theorem proof : FFNConj.none_loopfree_inter := by
  unfold FFNConj.none_loopfree_inter
  intro S T h1
  simp_all [RC.C0, FF.LoopFree, FF.Matching, FF.NonEmpty, G4.C4Free, G4.adj, G4.verts]
end FFNP1

modules.name: FFNP5
modules.source:

namespace FFNP5
theorem proof : FFNConj.none_nonempty_inter_negation := by
  unfold FFNConj.none_nonempty_inter_negation FFNConj.none_nonempty_inter
  intro h
  exact absurd (h (({(2, 2)} : GT.Edges)) (({(0, 1)} : GT.Edges)) (by first | decide +kernel | (intro v; omega) | omega | (intros; omega))) (by decide +kernel)
end FFNP5
